name: pnpc-mcp-tally-prime
description: PNPC's connector for reading from and writing to TallyPrime (ledgers, vouchers, P&L, balance sheet, stock, SQL cache) directly from Claude.

tally_url.title: Tally Gateway URL
tally_url.description: TallyPrime's HTTP gateway address. Change the port here if you're running more than one Tally connector on this machine and need to avoid a port conflict (Tally's own default gateway port is 9000).

read_only_mode.title: Read-only mode
read_only_mode.description: When on (the default), every write tool (create/update/delete) is blocked before it ever reaches Tally — this connector can only look, never change anything. Turn this off deliberately once you're ready to let it post vouchers or update masters. Requires fully restarting Claude Desktop to take effect.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools (advanced)
disabled_tools.description: Optional comma-separated exact tool names to block regardless of the read-only setting above, e.g. delete_voucher,delete_master to allow writes but forbid deletion. Leave blank to allow everything not already blocked by read-only mode.
